criteria.requirement: Connection profiles require an explicit provider, model, HTTPS endpoint and credential reference; local test mode stays loopback-only.
Remote managed execution is denied unless the exact profile is registered, consented with limits and its credential reference is set.
The managed executor and its tools never receive the credential; an offline relay forwards only bounded requests for the selected model.
The provider registry lists registered connections without printing credential values or contacting endpoints.
Runtime, packaging, public site, tooling, catalog and secret checks pass.
